create_dpt_config: create a DPTConfig instance with default dpt-large style configuration parameters
create_dpt_config_hybrid: create a DPTConfig instance with is_hybrid enabled and a BIT backbone configuration
create_dpt_config_custom: create a DPTConfig instance with custom image_size patch_size and hidden_size values
create_dpt_config_readout: create a DPTConfig instance with readout_type set to ignore add or project
create_dpt_config_backbone: create a DPTConfig instance with a custom backbone_config dictionary or PreTrainedConfig
